Author: shifusen329
Name: Raid Replay
Punchline: Replay and analyze raid pulls from your ACT network logs.
Description:
Reconstructs every pull from ACT network logs: arena map, waymarks, player positions and facing, boss casts and AoE telegraphs, towers, tethers, head markers and deaths, with a scrubbable timeline. Watches the live log and explains each wipe right after it happens: root cause, who was where, and where they should have been.

Alpha: requires ACT with the FFXIV plugin writing network logs (default folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\Advanced Combat Tracker\FFXIVLogs). /aar opens the after-action report, /raidreplay the replay window.
Changelog: 0.0.2 (alpha): Dancing Mad Phase 3 through Earthquake (sections, Chaos/Exdeath, crystals, attack shapes, limit-cut numbers, mitigation sheet), P3 wipe explanations (earth crystal double cleanse, Umbra Smash landing on the party), late P2 sections, /rr shortcut, in-game look for Tele-trouncing teleporters, P1 Kefka now drawn, fixes to spread/stack judgement and death recaps. 0.0.1: first test build.
